featureDefinitions.epaDiff: Home minus away opponent-adjusted net EPA from the prospectively frozen CFBD WEPA snapshot; PPA remains separate.
featureDefinitions.explosivenessDiff: Home minus away mean yards on successful offensive plays.
featureDefinitions.linePlayDiff: Home minus away net line yards, where team net = offensive lineYards minus defensive lineYardsAllowed, from week-bounded CFBD advanced stats.
featureDefinitions.paceDiff: Home minus away offensive plays per completed game.
featureDefinitions.ppaDiff: Home minus away mean CFBD play PPA through completed games before snapshot.
featureDefinitions.qbContinuityDiff: Home minus away audited QB continuity from official pregame depth-chart evidence; remains null without deterministic validation.
featureDefinitions.restDaysDiff: Home minus away days since most recent completed game.
featureDefinitions.successRateDiff: Home minus away conventional down-and-distance success rate.
featureDefinitions.travelMilesDiff: Home minus away great-circle miles from each program's registered CFBD home location to the game venue.
featureDefinitions.windMph: Open-Meteo 10m sustained wind nearest kickoff from the forecast captured at snapshot time; confirmed domes are explicitly set to 0.

summary.reason: BR2 remains collection-only until the frozen feature contract has point-in-time coverage and an untouched future holdout.
